components.description: Federal FMLA leave as set out in OSU Policy 3-0708: up to 12 weeks of job-protected leave in a 12-month period for the birth and care of a child, adoption or foster placement, the employee's own serious health condition, or care of a spouse, child or parent with a serious health condition; runs concurrently with OSU paid leaves; faculty and staff on all OSU campuses.

notes: The handbook text (2018_01_note.txt) lacks printed page 48 (Policy Statement 1.4.5-1.5.2, a scanned page). In the PDF (2018_01_note.pdf), p.48 carries 1.4.8, 1.4.8.1-1.4.8.2 with the margin note 'Policy modification approved by the OSU Board of Regents on March 7, 2008', word for word as in 2018_04. Quotes for 1.4.8 are therefore taken from 2018_04 (whose approval history lists no change to these sections after 2008); no version_uncertain flag.

The no-policy coding (`missing`) does not apply: the usable sources include governing documents for faculty leave covering tenure-stream faculty (the Policy Statement in the Faculty Handbook, 1.4.8 tenure clock and 1.10 faculty leaves; OSU P&P 2-0113 Faculty Sick Leave; OSU P&P 3-0708 FMLA, which applies to faculty and staff). missing = false.

No paid parental, maternity or childbirth leave and no modified duties or teaching relief appear in any saved document. Policy Statement 1.10.1 names maternity and paternity as 'qualified conditions' under a 'flexible health leave policy' that it does not identify by number; the only saved faculty health-leave policy is 2-0113 (sick leave). Pay for a birth comes only from the faculty member's own accrued sick leave (c2, c3).
Sabbatical leave (1.10.2) is not a component: it is for professional development under an approved programme, which a parent could not take for the birth.

FMLA 3.07 reduced or intermittent schedule is for employee or family illness only and is a form of FMLA leave (c1), so C8 and part_time_option are absent; 3.07B transfer to an alternative position accommodates intermittent illness leave, not pregnancy (C9 absent).

c4 and c5 are the same Policy Statement 1.10.3 leave without pay: c4 is the leave as a general-purpose leave (flagged, counted nowhere); c5 is the route 2-0113 3.01K gives to it once illness (own or dependent's) exhausts sick leave, coded as medical/family-illness leave (discretionary) with 1.10.3's length. 3-0708 3.14's 'personal leave of absence' after FMLA exhaustion is read as this leave.

c6 entitlement: 1.4.8.1 says the FMLA extension 'shall be granted upon approval by the VPAA and the Board of Regents' while 1.4.8 says a general extension 'may be granted upon approval'; coded guaranteed_on_request and flagged ambiguous. c6 use_limit (2 per career) is my reading of 1.4.8.2: a second FMLA extension is granted, and a third may only be requested under 1.4.8.
c8 payer employee_paid rests on 3-0708 3.11B listing long-term disability among 'Benefits normally paid for by the employee'; the plan document (P&P 3-0750) is not saved.
FMLA statute: length and eligibility verified against statute texts 2026_00 and 2026_01 (2026 text; 12 workweeks unchanged since 1993, per the baseline row).
Faculty annual (vacation) leave is mentioned in 3-0708 3.08B ('accrued compensatory, annual, or sick leave') but no faculty annual-leave policy is saved; recorded in c1 must_exhaust_first only.

Documents cited but not saved: OSU P&P 3-0750 (University disability program / Long Term Salary Continuance Group Insurance Plan) [flagged on c8]; the 'flexible health leave policy' of Policy Statement 1.10.1 [flagged on c2]; OSU P&P 3-0716 Sick Leave for Staff (staff only); P&P 2-0902, 2-0903, 2-0904, 2-0905 (appointment, clinical, research, Regents Professor procedures); 2-0901 (Ombudsperson); 1-0702 (affirmative action); 3-0701 section 3.03 (exceptions authority); 2-0215 (academic program review); the FMLA Certification of Health Care Provider form said to be attached to 3-0708 (not in the saved text); the Board 'Board Appellate Procedures' (1968); AAUP Policy Documents and Reports (1990); FMLA regulations.

Birth parent chain: FMLA 12 weeks (c1), with own sick leave (c2) and the five birth/adoption sick days (c3) drawn within it -> discretionary leave without pay for own illness after sick leave and FMLA are exhausted, normally up to one year (c5); long-term salary continuation application after sick leave is exhausted (c8, no length). Tenure clock: FMLA extension one year (c6).

Non-birth parent chain: FMLA 12 weeks (c1), with the five birth/adoption sick days (c3) and sick leave to care for an ill or incapacitated wife (c2) within it -> discretionary leave without pay for a dependent's illness after sick leave and FMLA are exhausted (c5). Tenure clock: FMLA extension one year (c6).
calendar: the handbook names semesters (e.g. 'the end of the spring semester') without a length; calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. No component is measured in terms.
